overview: Medford High School media technology students produced this video report featuring school events, athletic achievements, and musical performances.

items.title: Introduction and Senior Breakfast
items.summary: Victoria Rasche and Katrina Rasche introduced the media technology class production and highlighted the recent senior breakfast.

items.title: AP Spanish Musical Performance
items.summary: Students in the AP Spanish class performed a musical rendition of Cascabeles.

items.title: Girls Basketball Update
items.summary: Katrina Rasche reported on a recent victory by the girls basketball team over Boston Latin.

items.title: Gymnastics Team Feature
items.summary: The segment featured the athletic skills of gymnastics team captain Renee Stoudy.

items.title: Student Vocal Performance
items.summary: A student performed a vocal solo for the Mustang Report production.

items.title: TD Garden Basketball Announcement
items.summary: Students announced an upcoming boys basketball game against Arlington Catholic scheduled for January 24th at the TD Garden.
